title: Phoenix Intro: Replace Static Image with Video Animation + Synced Sound Effect

requirements.text: In PhoenixIntro.tsx, remove the static phoenix bird image entirely. Replace it with an HTML5 <video> element that uses the file 'phoenix.mp4' (placed in frontend/public/assets/) as its source. The video must be centered on screen, autoplay, start muted, and display with a smooth CSS fade-in effect. Surround it with a fiery orange/red radial glow (box-shadow or drop-shadow filter) consistent with the existing orange/red phoenix theme.

quotes: REMOVE static phoenix bird image completely.
Instead, use the provided PHOENIX VIDEO animation.
Phoenix video must appear centered on screen with fiery orange glow.
Video should play automatically when intro begins.
Use smooth fade-in effect for video.

acceptanceCriteria: No static phoenix image is rendered anywhere in the intro sequence.
A <video> element plays automatically when the intro screen mounts.
The video starts muted.
The video fades in smoothly (CSS opacity transition) from 0 to 1.
The video is centered horizontally and vertically on the screen.
A fiery orange/red glow effect is applied around the video.

requirements.text: Add an HTML5 <audio> element to PhoenixIntro.tsx that uses the file 'phoenix-sound.mp3' (placed in frontend/public/assets/) as its source. Configure it with loop=false, volume=0.5 (medium/cinematic level). When the video's 'onplay' event fires, unmute the video and call audio.play(). When the video's 'onended' event fires, immediately call audio.pause() and reset audio.currentTime to 0. The sound must not loop and must not continue playing after the intro finishes.

quotes: Attach the provided phoenix flying sound effect to the video.
When phoenix starts flying upward → PLAY SOUND.
Sound volume medium (not loud, cinematic level).
When flying animation ends → IMMEDIATELY STOP SOUND.
Sound must NOT loop.
Sound must NOT continue after intro finishes.
video.onplay → start audio
video.onended → stop audio + navigate home

acceptanceCriteria: An <audio> element is present in the intro component referencing 'phoenix-sound.mp3'.
Audio plays when the video's play event fires.
Audio volume is set to 0.5.
Audio stops immediately when the video ends.
Audio does not loop.
Audio does not continue after the intro transitions to the Home page.

requirements.text: Synchronize the text animations in PhoenixIntro.tsx with the phoenix video playback. As the video plays: (1) The text 'Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering' animates upward in sync with the phoenix flight — use a CSS translateY transition triggered when the video begins playing. (2) After the department text rises, the big title 'VibECX-2K26' appears with a fade-in and scale-up effect. (3) Then the subtitle '2K26' appears below it. All text must remain in Times New Roman, clear and readable, with the existing orange/red neon glow styling.

quotes: Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering moves upward along with phoenix flight.
Then BIG TITLE appears: VibECX-2K26
Then subtitle: 2K26
Times New Roman text must remain clear and readable.

acceptanceCriteria: Department name text animates upward (translateY) when the video starts playing.
'VibECX-2K26' title appears after the department text rises, with a fade-in and/or scale effect.
'2K26' subtitle appears after the main title.
All text uses Times New Roman font.
Text is clearly readable against the video background with orange/red glow styling.
Text animations are visually synchronized with the video duration (approx. 7–8 seconds).

requirements.text: In the video's 'onended' event handler inside PhoenixIntro.tsx, after stopping the audio, trigger a smooth full-screen fade-out (opacity 0) transition on the entire intro container, then call the existing onComplete() callback to navigate to the Home page. There must be no loading screen between the intro and the Home page.

quotes: After video animation ends → smoothly fade into Home page.
No loading screen.
video.onended → stop audio + navigate home

acceptanceCriteria: When the video ends, the intro screen fades out smoothly (CSS opacity transition to 0).
After the fade-out, the app navigates directly to the Home page.
No loading screen or intermediate screen appears during the transition.
The audio is fully stopped before or during the fade-out.

constraints: All text in the intro must remain in Times New Roman font.
The fiery orange/red color theme must be preserved throughout the intro.
Audio must not loop and must not play outside the intro sequence.
Do not modify any immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Video and audio asset files (phoenix.mp4, phoenix-sound.mp3) must be placed in frontend/public/assets/ and referenced as static assets — do not route through the backend.
nonGoals: Adding any new backend logic or data persistence for the intro.
Modifying the QR payment flow, registration form, or any other pages.
Adding a loading screen between intro and Home page.
Changing the Home page or any page other than PhoenixIntro.tsx.
Adding music controls or volume UI.
